title: "Maker Movement" Approach to Computing; Basic Ethical Hacking
description: We will learn how to enumerate and exploit a variety of network services and misconfigurations, we will learn how to use Nmap - a powerful network scanning tool. We will learn how to use MetaSploit - a tool to probe and exploit vulnerabilities on networks and servers. We will practice web app hacking and privilege escalation and discuss man-in-the-middle attacks.
